[F]If all our life is but a dream,
[Bb]fantastic posing greed,

[Bb]the sea.

[F]

[Bb]genius only comes
[F]along in storms of fabled for-
[F]eign tongues.

[F]
Northern [Dm]Downpour sends its love.
[Bb]

[F]Sugar-

[Bb]easy morning, weather
[Dm]vanes my
[Bb]one and lonely.

[Verse 2]
[F]The ink is running toward the page,
[Bb]it's chasing off the days,
[F]look back at both feet and that wind-
[Bb]ing knee.
I missed your skin [Dm]when you were East,
[F]
you clicked your heels [Dm]and wished for me.
[Bb]
[F]Through playful lips made of yarn
[Bb]that fragile Capricorn
[F]unraveled words like moths upon
[F]old scarves.
I know the world's [Dm]a broken bone,
[F]
but melt your [Dm]headaches, call it home.
